0.0: Hey! I heard that you were finally able to enter the castle. Is that true? Well then, please... Could you please find my brother for me?

yes.0: Both of our parents passed away when we were young, so I basically raised my brother growing up. Ever since I became a Security Officer, we lived together within the castle walls, but when the evacuations happened, I was too busy protecting the Mushking to realize that I had left my brother inside.
yes.1: He's lived there practically since birth, so he knows every corner of the castle. He's probably hiding quietly somewhere inside, hoping to be rescued. Please rescue my brother for me.

no.0: He's my only brother... please reconsider.

1.0: I... I am scared... Please...please help me...

yes.0: What? My brother sent you here? Ahhh... I am safe now. Thank you so much...
